summary: One-frame notice that a player's request to toggle free turn-based (FTB) mode was refused on the client, with the reason. Never seen alive. Same shape as its sibling ecl::ftb::BlockedFTBRequestOneFrameComponent (alive layout: int16 PlayerId, uint8 Reason). Registry total 4 (client row).

fields.name: PlayerId
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1956DB0 (AllocRaw 4, `*(undefined4*)p = 0`). Its only caller chain bg3.exe+0x1956B30 <- bg3.exe+0x1956820 writes `*(short*)p = sVar7` where sVar7 is the low 16 bits of the uint at +0x12C of the character (0 or values >= 0x10000 skipped) - the same player id the sibling BlockedFTBRequestOneFrameComponent stores at +0.

fields.name: Reason
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1956820 writes `*(char*)(p+2)` = 0 when FUN_140785360(entity) is true (it tests eoc::death::DeathComponent: the character is dead), 1 when the component read by FUN_140af5820 has flag bits set (byte +0x48 and flags & ~4, or flag 0x10), 2 when FUN_140ab2040(entity) is true; otherwise no component is made and net message 0xE9 is sent to the server instead (the toggle goes through).

fields.name: _Pad3
fields.evidence: padding; registry size 4; zeroed by the creator's 4-byte store.

open_questions: What exactly reasons 0/1/2 mean (the checks FUN_140785360, FUN_140af5820 flags, FUN_140ab2040 are not named); no reader found besides the generic one-frame clean-up bg3.exe+0x762CA0.
Not seen alive (seen.py has no samples).
